objective: Describe how light and sound behave and identify safe ways to protect people.

items.prompt: Which helps us see in a dark room?
items.explanation: A lamp gives off light, which lets us see in a dark room. Shouts, blankets, and cars do not make light.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use sound?  (in this lesson: Light and Sound Lab)

options.text: cover your ears at a very loud concert

items.explanation: Very loud music can hurt your ears, so covering them keeps your hearing safe.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use light?  (in this lesson: Light and Sound Lab)

options.text: count the books on a shelf
do not point a laser at your eyes
name a color in the room

items.explanation: A laser is very bright and can damage your eyes, so never point one at anyone's eyes.

items.prompt: Which example shows how sound behaves?  (in this lesson: Light and Sound Lab)

options.text: a lamp lights a dark room

items.explanation: Clapping makes your hands vibrate, and that makes sound. Lamps, mirrors, and windows are about light.

items.prompt: Which example shows how light behaves?  (in this lesson: Light and Sound Lab)

options.text: a whistle makes a high sound
a lamp lights a dark room
a drum makes sound when struck

items.explanation: A lamp gives off light, so it lets us see in a dark room. Drums, whistles, and claps make sound.
